newsitem.title: UK: Rank slips ahead of results.
newsitem.headline: Rank slips ahead of results.

text.p: Shares in Rank Group Plc slipped on Wednesday amid jitters that the leisure group's annual profits won't meet market expectations, dealers said.
By 1129 GMT, the shares were down 8p to 412, a day ahead of the results.
The group was expected to post sharply lower annual profits after around 185 million pounds of restructuring charges and poperty write-offs.
Normalised pretax profits are expected at 283 million to 330 million stg, compared with 658 million pounds last year.
"There's some nervousness that the results will be quite bad. That's the rumour," said one market maker.
The shares have underperformed the rest of the UK market by more than 20 percent during the past 12 months. --London newsroom +44-171-542-4026
